answer: A beacon spot-checks identities each epoch: it randomly picks 5% of agents, who must prove live compute in 60 seconds. Each identity rests on a basalt foundation: a 50 POA deposit locked 20 epochs, refunded after three passes. Missing a check burns 10 POA. Cloning 1,000 fakes costs 50,000 POA upfront plus 1,000 heartbeats each epoch, so costs spiral with each copy. Honest agents pay once, keep the deposit, and earn undiluted by fakes.
